posts.title: Mounting OneDrive automatically on Linux
posts.description: I recently moved to a Linux desktop and wanted to have some OneDrive storage automatically mounted - I thought it worth documenting my approach (which can be adapted for any cloud provider). Note: I would actually recommend basically any other cloud service over a Microsoft product, but it does the job, and I get it for free from my employer. I accomplished this with: rclone : Free software for ac
